tweets.text:
“Why Pretraining Fails to Share Cross-Lingual Knowledge”

LLM's knowledge learned in one language Sometimes barely transfers to another.

This paper identifies that the failure starts during pretraining and that disjoint token spaces alone can cause it, even between two otherwise identical copies of English.

Mapping languages into a shared semantic token space improves cross-lingual learning by up to 14x, suggesting tokenization itself is a major bottleneck to truly shared multilingual knowledge.

https://t.co/oRUNxnn3FS

“Demystifying Reinforcement Learning Post-Training of Language Models”

Sparse RLVR mostly amplifies behaviors the base model can already sample.

This paper shows dense process rewards can overcome that exploration bottleneck and learn near-zero-probability behaviors, pushing one AIME task from 3.9% to 92.2%.

It also explains spurious reward gains as prompt-distribution effects, not evidence that random rewards are generally useful.

https://t.co/SzxvbsaOsU

"Gated Recurrent Transformers: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation"

Gated Recurrent Transformers decouple depth from parameter count by repeatedly reusing a small shared Transformer core rather than assigning unique weights to every layer.

So a learned elementwise gate, conditioned on both the current hidden state and a fixed prelude representation, decides what information to preserve or rewrite at each recurrence. This gives the same weights different behavior at different depths. 

Under matched FLOPs, GRT matches GPT-2 Small with 35M vs 124M parameters, while the large model cuts parameters by ~62% and peak decoding memory by ~59%.

The interesting part is that recurrence depth becomes an inference-time compute hyperparam. More recurrent steps give the model more latent computation without increasing parameter count or producing extra reasoning tokens.

https://t.co/Ubj4k0C2rW

tweets.text:
The big model labs are fighting.. this was inevitable. 

Watch as subsidized token prices go up in <6 months as price of compute and shortages start being “actually” felt. Say goodbye to your reset limits. 

Great for customer choice in the long run. And add another $1-30B in valuation to all the open harnesses in the short run 😅

Resist dunking*

I see it WAY too much with folks especially today. It’s the perfect dopamine loop - other people join in and you feel great. But, it just screams envy and doesn’t lead to anything productive. 

Sure, you can pat yourself on the back and say “see I told you so” but how did it move the world? Nowhere. If you think you can do it better, go do that then. Screaming about someone’s unfair advantages is not going to change your life - and probably leads to more sadness. 

Keep building. Continue to change the world. That’s the best way to have impact. Choose kindness above all else. 

* the only caveat here is if you’re calling out obvious fraud, or pointing out something that’s woefully bad, do it. there are very clearly some businesses that are going to be vaporware and if you have evidence call it out. that doesn’t scream envy, it’s factual and not dunking by any means.

It takes great taste and judgment to see what’s possible, and strong conviction & execution to actually make it happen 
@fal 🤝 @MiniMax_AI https://t.co/XlRuq63z4O

Some milestones move a leaderboard. A rare few change how you see the future.

MiniMax H3 Max did both.

We released MiniMax H3 as an open-weight model with the hope that the community would adapt it, challenge it, and take it further than we could alone. 

@fal did exactly that. 

With its own post-training and inference expertise, pushed the frontier on both quality and latency, and created experiences that simply weren't possible before. Faster-than-real-time video is no longer just an idea. It is opening the door to perpetual streams, interactive worlds, real-time storytelling, and experiences we are only beginning to imagine.

They made the value of open weights feel real to our team in a way it hadn't before. 

Advancing technology together has always been a core belief at MiniMax. H3 Max made that belief tangible. 

It showed that the frontier no longer belongs to a few, it belongs to everyone willing to build, experiment, and share what they discover.

We hope H3 Max is the first of many breakthroughs shaped by different teams. To every builder ready to push video forward: our weights are open, our door is open, and we're ready to stand behind you.

Let's build, together. ✨
